title: Evaluating Robustness of Large Audio Language Models to Audio Injection: An Empirical Study

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to Context Injection Attacks (CIA) where malicious audio containing gender-biased contextual information is injected into male and female voice monologues. The outputs are assessed using human evaluation criteria and an LLM-as-a-judge across dimensions such as gender stereotypes, professional capability, emotion/behavior evaluation, and work-life balance.
